claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_selection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Subclass selection at level 3 is a one-time character-progression choice with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three. No existing family or ClassFeatureEffect kind can honestly represent 'at this level, choose a subclass and permanently gain its feature track.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Rogue subclass of your choice. The Thief subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Rogue levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Rogue level or lower.
